content: Yesus gidu jayai.

Juda nebere bori nomo Fati usu wainga, Maria Makdalaha wainga, Maria Jems Josep ngare anyanere wainga, Salome wainga, nere faronga bagu dada ila agiya hilou-hilou waha bagu ejiya wane. Nere goidu Yesus gogala langa bisemu wodbode ono wane.
Bori nomo fati amugou gai eringe amina, nere matmat langa goyane.
Nere goi bode, nere nage-nage benou leguruwane, “Faiwei ete no ere hoyo higidu megebu matmat u-u sesemu wane waha, ubeludu aririmu hagage yo?”
Saini nere matmat langa maidu jugu bode igei wane wa, megebu matmat u-u sesemu wou walanga inyei uwa. Nere megebu waha ubelumudu aririmu wou urane. Megebu waha no gai anyakaro.
Nere maidu matmat huwanya langa goi bode, magana giila ete nomo kolos kaamba ufaro bagu, owo hilou langa yafa gainga uredu, horoto wane.

Ono wanenga no benou lenigai, “Tere adai horoto wagu. Ji isini, tere Yesus Nasaretha nauge abalakawou langa tofiye tuwane waha, kuru tuwagu ganga maiyaha. No amina jayaha. No belanga inyei uwa. Uragu, haumu belanga no tafa tuwaneha.
Waha bona tere goidu nomo disaipel lenigi bonade, Pita fere letuwagu, ‘Yesus no tere amuge tigidu bona, Galili langa goina. Tere no amina letigai onou, goidu Galili walanga uragu ganga.’”
Ono wainga, aita nere malala maidu bode, matmat awadu hara waneha. Nere aau togo nagainga terere bode, fai ete te letu weguwa, nere umuganeha.
Maria Makdalaha no Yesus urai.
Yesus no eringe amina bori nomo fati amugou langa jayaiha. Onodu no Maria Magdalaha heigei uwa inyi gainga, no amugedu heigaiha. Yesus no amina aita waha langa hauri inyaba 7 so nigaiha.
Ono wainga, Maria Magdalaha no goidu bona, fai Yesus ngate gaara golowane waha lenigai. Fai waha nere aau togo nagainga mere bode yafane.
Maria no benou lenigai, “Yesus no ago auma yafa gainga urenaha.” Ono wainga, nere nomo beele waha isidu, huwanyanege ngalengawei uwa.
Yesus nomo disaipel nga, nere Yesus jala langa urare.
Iinga Yesus nomo disaipel nga nere taon awadu bodere golodu goyare. Ono garenga, Yesus no hogo ferete heigedu bona, goi nere bagu heigai.
Ono wainga nere goidu bodere, beele waha malalamudu Yesus nomo disaipel ila hai nagareha. Ono ware wa, nere neire beele waha bodere huwayange ngalenga weguwa.
Yesus no nomo disaipel nere haruwe tei nomo bona lenigai.

Iinga Yesus nomo disaipel 11, nere da nyibode yafa ganenga, Yesus nere langa heigai. Onodu nere huwanyanege ngalengawou uwau bona honggoro nigai, onowai wa nere huwanyanege sese wainga, nere fai-aita bagu no gidu jayai waha bode lewane waha, nere huwanyanege ngalengawei uwa.
Onodu no benou lenigai, “Tere ha-ha oruwa langa goidu hilou beele malalamudu fai-aita bagu oruwanga hai nagagu.
Fai no huwanya ngalenga wonga yaage bisou tona waha, Itou no ege gidu hawonbona. Ariya fai no huwanya ngalengawei uwa waha, no kot langa yaae wonbona.
Itou no dodokawou fai nere huwanyanege ngalengade waha owonege langa heigemu wonbona. Ji unyife langa hauri inyaba so nigibode, beele eege hogo fere-fere waha malalamudu lewodbode.

Nere maangi owonege langa yaasu wodbode. Onodu, nere dada fai dunege kotena waha nyei mata wode wa, dada waha nere ada inyabamu nigonbona. Onodu nere taura fai langa owonege tafabode wonga, taura fai taura ege jige nigona bona.”
Itou no Yesus haudu ha laluwa langa manai.
Anyakaro Yesus no beele malalamudu lenigi boro wainga, Itou no Yesus haudu ha laluwa langa manai. No Itou owo hilou langa yafana.
Ono wainga disaipel nere ha-ha oruwa langa goidu bode beele malalamudu lewaneha. Anyakaro no nere bagu haruwe tebona, no nebere beele dangamu nagi bona dodoka ila heigemuwai.
